	title = cosmo_affairs_events.40576.t
	desc = cosmo_affairs_events.40576.d
	picture = {
	trigger = {	
		has_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_MIAO_ARTIST_1		
	}
	picture = cosmogfx_AFFAIR_ADVISOR_MIAO_ARTIST_1_eventPicture
	}
	picture = {
	trigger = {		
		has_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_MIAO_ARTIST_2
	}
	picture = cosmogfx_AFFAIR_ADVISOR_MIAO_ARTIST_2_eventPicture
	}	
	picture = {
	trigger = {
		has_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_MIAO_ARTIST_3
	}
	picture = cosmogfx_AFFAIR_ADVISOR_MIAO_ARTIST_3_eventPicture
	}	
		picture = {
	trigger = {	
		has_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_MIAO_ARTIST_4		
	}
	picture = cosmogfx_AFFAIR_ADVISOR_MIAO_ARTIST_4_eventPicture
	}
	picture = {
	trigger = {	
		has_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_MIAO_ARTIST_5		
	}
	picture = cosmogfx_AFFAIR_ADVISOR_MIAO_ARTIST_5_eventPicture
	}
	picture = {
	trigger = {	
		has_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_MIAO_ARTIST_6		
	}
	picture = cosmogfx_AFFAIR_ADVISOR_MIAO_ARTIST_6_eventPicture
	}	
		
	
	goto = advisorprovince
	is_triggered_only = yes

	immediate = {
		hidden_effect = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					has_country_flag = cosmo_subjects_advisor
				}
				FROM = {
					capital_scope = {
						save_event_target_as = advisorprovince
					}
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = {
						has_country_flag = cosmo_subjects_advisor
					}
				}
					capital_scope = {
						save_event_target_as = advisorprovince
					}
			}
		
			if = {
			limit = {
				NOT = {
				has_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_MIAO_ARTIST_1
				has_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_MIAO_ARTIST_2
				has_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_MIAO_ARTIST_3
				has_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_MIAO_ARTIST_4
				has_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_MIAO_ARTIST_5
				has_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_MIAO_ARTIST_6
				}
			}
			set_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_MIAO_ARTIST_1		
		}						
		}
	}
	
		option = {
		name = cosmo_affairs_events.40576.a				
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_MIAO_ARTIST_6
			}
			clr_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_MIAO_ARTIST_6
		}		
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_MIAO_ARTIST_5
			}
			set_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_MIAO_ARTIST_6
			clr_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_MIAO_ARTIST_5
		}			
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_MIAO_ARTIST_4
			}
			set_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_MIAO_ARTIST_5
			clr_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_MIAO_ARTIST_4
		}			
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_MIAO_ARTIST_3
			}
			set_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_MIAO_ARTIST_4
			clr_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_MIAO_ARTIST_3
		}			
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_MIAO_ARTIST_2
			}
			set_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_MIAO_ARTIST_3
			clr_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_MIAO_ARTIST_2
		}		
		if = {
			limit = {
				has_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_MIAO_ARTIST_1
			}
			set_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_MIAO_ARTIST_2
			clr_country_flag = AFFAIR_ADVISOR_MIAO_ARTIST_1
		}	
		cosmo_admadvisor_fail = yes												 												

		remove_country_modifier = having_an_affair
		
		hidden_effect = {
			clr_ruler_flag = ruler_having_affair				
	   
		}		
	}			
}

# Administrative philosopher inspired
country_event = {
	id = cosmo_affairs_events.4111
	title = cosmo_affairs_events.4111.t
	desc = cosmo_affairs_events.4111.d
	picture = {
	trigger = { 
		employed_advisor = {
				is_male = no
				culture = castillian
				type = philosopher 
			}
		}
	picture = cosmogfx_AFFAIR_ADVISOR_CASTILLIAN_PHILOSOPHER_1_eventPicture
	}
	picture = {
	trigger = {	
		employed_advisor = {
				is_male = no
				culture = portugese
				type = philosopher 
			}		
	}
	picture = cosmogfx_AFFAIR_ADVISOR_PORTUGESE_PHILOSOPHER_1_eventPicture
	}	

	
	
	is_triggered_only = yes

	immediate = {
	hidden_effect = {	
			random_list = { #advisor
			33 = { 
				set_ruler_flag = cosmo_advisor_adm
			}
			33 = { 
				set_ruler_flag = cosmo_advisor_dip
			}
			33 = { 
				set_ruler_flag = cosmo_advisor_mil
			}			
		}		
		}
	}
		
		option = {
		name = cosmo_affairs_events.4111.a
				cosmo_philosopher_affair = yes														

		remove_country_modifier = having_an_affair
		
		hidden_effect = {
			clr_ruler_flag = ruler_having_affair				

	   
		}		
	}			
}
